description: U.S. Street Network Shapefiles, Node/Edge Lists, and GraphML Files is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Geoff Boeing (Northeastern University). Shapefiles, node/edge lists, and GraphML files of the street networks of every city/town, urbanized area, county, census tract, and Zillow neighborhood in the United States. Street networks include public drivable streets. Created from OpenStreetMap data using the a href="https://github.com/gboeing/osmnx" OSMnx /a software. Full methodological details in the related publications. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2017. Formats: ZIP. Size stated: 38879860. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
